---
name: dependency-audit
description: Full evidence-based dependency and software supply-chain audit.
disable-model-invocation: true
---

Use the Dependency Guardian for a read-only dependency audit.

Inventory actual manifests and lockfiles, direct/transitive dependencies, action references, container files where present, license data, advisories, release health, and update compatibility. Evaluate exploitability and the critical product paths affected. Do not invent CVEs, package versions, or release notes.

Return a prioritized report, safe target versions supported by evidence, test plan, rollback plan, and list of unverified manifests. Do not merge, publish, or deploy.
